messages:
hiro: FYI - bringing up quant4b_jp reranker on onboard_jp cohort; seeing an MRR drop on JP queries vs fp16 while NDCG@10 barely moves.
emma: numbers?
hiro: fp16 MRR 0.512 -> quant4b_jp 0.469; NDCG@10 fp16 0.801 -> 0.795
prasanna: is this only for Japanese? english cohorts unaffected?
hiro: en cohort pretty flat. regression reproduces only on jp-locale cohort.
yuki: did we change punctuation/normalization for CJK? we enabled NFKC + strip ZWSP last week in candidate normalizer.
emma: tokenizer changes too: mecab model bumped + spm merge rule tweak. metadata: tokenizer=spm-mecab, tokenizer_sha=spm-mecab-2025cd
prasanna: short queries are sensitive to first-token splits in jp. could be a tokenization boundary shift. try a pretokenized run to isolate.
eval-bot: queued job: https://ci.redwood/evals/1799999010/quant4b_jp-pretokenized (job id 1799999020)
hiro: concrete example: query "APIキーをリセットするには"
- fp16 tokens: [<s>, API, キー, を, リセット, する, に, は]
- quant tokens: [<s>, API, キ, ー, を, リセット, する, に, は]
splitting 'キー' into two pieces in quant path. that can change embedding for the whole query, esp for short Qs.
emma: that would explain larger MRR drop vs ndcg (top1 flips but top10 still ok).
prasanna: pretokenized run finished: quant4b_jp with pretokenized inputs -> MRR 0.511 (matches fp16).
hiro: so runtime tokenization mismatch is root cause. short-term mitigation: force pretokenize for jp onboarding and revert mecab bump in the tokenization docker image for onboard builds.
yuki: I'll open a PR to make the runtime validate tokenizer_sha against eval metadata and fail fast if mismatched.
sam: also add a small deterministic jp top1 stability test in rankbench that runs a 2k goldset through both tokenizers and asserts top1 delta < 1%.
hiro: action items:
- (hiro) revert mecab bump for onboarding images / rollback if infra approves
- (yuki) PR: tokenizer sha enforcement + log token diffs
- (prasanna) add jp top1 stability test to rankbench
- (emma) attach token-diff csv to onboarding ticket for auditors
hiro: tagging infra @infra-team for quick rollback permission :rotating_light:
eval-bot: job 1799999020 finished - logs and per-query token-diff CSV attached.
hiro: thanks all, will update the onboarding ticket when the rollback and tests land. :white_check_mark:
